verdict.rationale: No evidence describes CrewAI providing explicit data retention/deletion controls (e.g., memory purge policies, log retention settings, GDPR-style deletion tools) for either the open-source framework or its enterprise/AMP offering; memory and observability docs describe storage and tracking but not retention/deletion management. The Show HN example of an agent auto-deleting emails is a user-built workflow, not a CrewAI platform privacy control, and a commenter even criticizes the default deletion behavior as too aggressive without recourse.
